verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures and layout. Variable chunking splits at semantic boundaries to produce embedding-sized chunks, and tables come in several output formats, so the LLM-ready structured output part of the story is documented. Nothing in the evidence shows repeated headers, footers or other page furniture being stripped, and markdown output is never explicitly mentioned. Missing for 10: documented header/footer/page-furniture removal, explicit markdown output, independent or hands-on corroboration of output cleanliness.
